findings.text: non-blocking: all 126 members are accounted for but only 17 carry an accepted repaired identity; 76 defective and 33 undecidable members remain lead entries, so the release bar of zero known defects is not reached by this node and rests on the filled lead questions.

non-blocking: check() never asserts a member row carries its before identity or a review score on every accepted axis, so a regression dropping either passes the gate; the shipped record shows radial_outline_of_flux_surface with docs_stage accepted and reviewer_score_docs null.
non-blocking: audit() loads and returns the equilibrium-adjudication module, so a reader cannot tell from the name that it drives no audit.

justifications.evidence: live-repair-check.log reports checked 126, complete true, sourceless 10 and EXIT=0 and I reproduced that EXIT=0 at head, but docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/equilibrium-repair.py:502 never asserts a member's before identity or a non-null review score, so two done_when clauses rest on inspection alone.
justifications.fit: the file follows the evidence-fragment idiom with a module docstring, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/equilibrium-repair.py:56 names the adjudication-module loader audit(), so that name states nothing it does.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/equilibrium-repair.json:329 shows 17 accepted repairs and 109 lead entries, so 109 of the 126 defective-or-undecidable members never reached the signed edit path, although the brief and done_when permit the lead listing.
justifications.reuse: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/equilibrium-repair.py:95 calls imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py:204 find_sourceless_live_name_rows, whose docstring calls a single enumeration the rule, and every mutation goes through the existing imas-codex sn CLI; the identity read is new and no owner for it exists under imas_codex/standard_names.
